```{r}
WT_vs_4preys_FEA = na.omit(WT_vs_4preys_FEA)
summary(WT_vs_4preys_FEA)
```
```{r}
WT_vs_4preys_FEA = subset(WT_vs_4preys_FEA, select = -c(X)) # remove X
```

```{r}
WT_vs_4preys_filteres = WT_vs_4preys_FEA[WT_vs_4preys_FEA$GeneNames != "No old locus tag",]
WT_vs_4preys_filteres = WT_vs_4preys_filteres[WT_vs_4preys_filteres$GeneNames != "",]
```

```{r}
WT_vs_4preys_final <- WT_vs_4preys_filteres[,-1]
rownames(WT_vs_4preys_final) <- WT_vs_4preys_filteres[,1]
```

```{r}
write.csv(WT_vs_4preys_final, "~/Documents/Data/WT_vs_4preys_final_V3.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```
